text: {"lessons":["From Periods 6–10, my account rose overall despite several down months; I should not let short-term fluctuations alone trigger trades.","A rising account value does not prove that every holding or past decision was sound; I should assess each position on its merits and its role in the portfolio.","Checking prices frequently can make small changes feel important, but I should act only when a considered decision—not the urge to respond to noise—supports a trade."]}
